question: Who holds the portfolio of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare in the 2024 cabinet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shivraj Singh Chouhan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shivraj Singh Chouhan i**s currently serving as the 32nd Minister of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare and 23rd Minister of Rural Development since June 10, 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• He previously served as the Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh from 2020 to 2023 and from 2005 to 2018.
 
• Chouhan has been a Member of the Legislative Assembly in Madhya Pradesh from Budhni since 2006 to 2024 and previously from 1990 to 1991.
 
• He holds the distinction of being the longest-serving Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Formerly, he was the National Vice President of the Bharatiya Janata Party from 2019 to 2020 and held positions in the party's Parliamentary Board and Central Election Committee.
 
• Chouhan also served as the National President of Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha from 2000 to 2002.
 
• He was a Member of Lok Sabha representing Vidisha from 1991 to 2005 and was elected to the 18th Lok Sabha from Vidisha as well.
 
• As a leader of the BJP, Chouhan held roles such as General Secretary and President of the Madhya Pradesh state unit.
 
• He joined the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) in 1972 at the age of 13.
 
• Known for launching various welfare schemes including rice at Rs 1 per kg for the poverty-stricken, Sambal scheme providing maternity assistance to women laborers, free education for poverty-stricken girls, fixed-rate electricity, Ladli Laxmi Yojana, and Beti Bachao Abhiyan.
 
• These welfare schemes are credited for the BJP's electoral victories in the 2008, 2013, and 2023 assembly elections.
